answer: Locks are recorded in lagoon, expire in terrace, and ferrous lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 193 aliases as a result needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Scaling to 823 identities multiplies that fee by 428 with no matching gain in influence. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
